visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with a black t-shirt and a smartwatch on his left wrist takes a large, enthusiastic bite of a round white dessert wrapped in plastic. His eyes squint as he tastes it, and white cream smears across his lips and cheeks. (2) A split-screen view appears; the top shows the man reacting to the food, while the bottom shows a macro close-up of the dessert's cross-section, revealing bright orange mango chunks, thick white cream, and a yellow sponge cake base. (3) The scene transitions to the man and a younger Caucasian man in a white sweatshirt standing in front of a bakery storefront. The younger man holds a blue-wrapped version of the dessert, pulling it apart to show a blueberry-colored filling to the camera. (4) Close-up shots highlight more varieties, specifically one containing a whole, large red strawberry surrounded by white cream. The men are outdoors on a city sidewalk with street traffic and scooters visible in the blurred background. (5) The younger man addresses the camera directly, holding a small blue box of the desserts. He gestures with his hands to emphasize his words while the older man stands beside him, still enjoying the snack under bright, natural daylight.
